checkedAlternates.risk: FCA and FOB both transfer risk upon handover to the carrier.
checkedAlternates.resolution: FCA applies to any transport mode including air/containerized rail (group-2), whereas FOB is restricted strictly to sea/inland waterway vessel loading (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: EXW applies to any mode of transport.
checkedAlternates.resolution: EXW places minimum obligation on the seller at their own premises (group-1), distinct from carrier-handed F/C rules (group-2).
